svg.title: OpsWatch
svg.desc: Self-hosted IT health monitoring modelled on the remote monitoring tools managed service providers use. Linux and Windows agents report to a FastAPI server over outbound HTTPS with token authentication.

g.text: Self-hosted IT health monitoring modelled on the remote monitoring tools managed service providers use.
Linux and Windows agents report to a FastAPI server over outbound HTTPS with token authentication.
Disk, services, backup age, TLS expiry,
Discord or Slack, plus a daily summary
